name: Accounts Receivable
description: Amounts owed to the business by customers for goods or services delivered

name: Accrued Revenue
description: Revenue earned but not yet billed or received

name: Petty Cash
description: Small cash fund for minor expenses

name: Checking Account
description: Primary business checking account

name: Savings Account
description: Business savings or money market account

name: Furniture & Fixtures
description: Office furniture, fixtures, and fittings

name: Machinery & Equipment
description: Production machinery, tools, and heavy equipment

name: Vehicles
description: Company-owned cars, trucks, and transport vehicles

name: Buildings
description: Owned buildings and structures

name: Leasehold Improvements
description: Improvements made to leased premises

name: Goodwill
description: Premium paid in an acquisition over the fair value of identifiable net assets

name: Patents
description: Patents and patent applications owned by the business

name: Trademarks
description: Registered trademarks and brand assets

name: Inventory
description: Goods held for sale in the ordinary course of business

name: Raw Materials
description: Materials used in the production of goods

name: Short-Term Investments
description: Marketable securities and short-term investment holdings

name: Prepaid Insurance
description: Insurance premiums that have been paid in advance

name: Prepaid Rent
description: Rent payments made in advance of the rental period

name: Security Deposits
description: Refundable deposits paid for leases, utilities, and services

name: Shareholder Loans Receivable
description: Loans made to shareholders or officers of the company

name: Accounts Payable
description: Amounts owed to suppliers and vendors for goods or services received

name: Accrued Wages
description: Wages and salaries earned by employees but not yet paid

name: Accrued Interest
description: Interest expense incurred but not yet paid

name: Credit Card Payable
description: Outstanding balances on company credit cards

name: Deferred Revenue

name: Customer Deposits
description: Deposits received from customers for future work

name: Line of Credit

name: Notes Payable (Short-Term)
description: Short-term promissory notes due within one year

name: Mortgage Payable
description: Long-term mortgage on business property

name: Bank Loan
description: Term loan from a bank or financial institution

name: Convertible Notes
description: Debt instruments that convert into equity at a future event

name: Payroll Tax Payable
description: Payroll taxes withheld or owed to tax authorities

name: Sales Tax Payable
description: Sales tax collected from customers pending remittance

name: Income Tax Payable
description: Estimated income taxes owed to government

name: Paid in Capital

name: Preferred Stock

name: Retained Earnings
